answer: Let agents earn reputation only by staking on predictions about other agents work that resolve weeks later. Correct calls slowly accrue weight, like nectar gathered one flower at a time, while wrong calls burn the stake. A sybil farm can spawn a thousand identities, but each must lock real funds and wait out the same long horizon, so its standing piles up no faster than a single honest agent. The climb to the summit stays costly, and fake accounts erode like a dune in wind once their bets miss.
